title: a beautiful picture that hangs in a vacuum
body: I used to adore this app, but time flows. Though it looks almost perfect at first glance while you testing it and playing with the demo project, in reality, the app has no integrations or public API, only poor mail-forwarding logic like it was in the late 90s. It’s also impossible to attach any file, even a photo. In addition, it displays Markdown text after finishing editing it in a really weird counterintuitive way, without the possibility of switching to the normal mode of formatted text. So, even UI by itself ceased to be an undeniable strong point. I don't understand why they shoot themselves in the leg, rejecting applying obvious improvements to such important things.

title: Super app
body: I researched loads of apps and trialed several before getting things. I previously had things 2 and that was good but things 3 is even better with iCal integration. I love the project aspect where you can put a list together for specific things and keep them for years if needed. It works seamlessly between the iPhone and Mac and it is super easy to add tasks and log when completed. Excellent all round.

title: After a long time of looking for the perfect organisation/productivity app I've finally found it
body: This is easily the best app I've used this year. A great redesign of an already good product that added tons of useful features! I'm hard to please and have lots of things I want to do in a single app like view my calendar, my to-dos, document my goals, create lists and projects, reminders, repeat task etc. and this is the first app that can do this and do it in a super simple and intuitive way. Highly recommended!
